summary: All 6 conceptual, kinematic, and consistency findings are cleanly resolved with zero regressions across the everyday watch model, Step 4 gear-ratio direction, CW hand / CCW escape-wheel kinematics, live draining HUD, jargon-free copy, and reachable slipping-clutch Lab/Practice cap. All 5 studio visual findings are cleanly resolved in light and dark modes with museum-grade 3-layer exhibition cutaway craft, 0% leader crossings, 0.196 min OKLab contrast, and generous UI breathing room on every step, Lab, and Practice view.

findings.text: Small steel pinions drive larger brass wheels inward from the escape wheel to step fast ticks down into seconds, minutes, and hours.
findings.finding: Step 4 caption, re-recorded voice narration, and HUD now accurately describe the gear-ratio reduction direction.

findings.text: Negated centerDeg across Steps 0-6 and Lab
findings.finding: centerWheel and fourthWheel now spin CW matching the watch hands, and escapePinion/escapeWheel spin CCW matching esc.escDeg and club-tooth rake.

findings.text: Dynamic live draining hudRows while liveReserve > 0
findings.finding: Step 6 now displays live coiled turns and 'Still ticking — draining down' while draining, switching to stopped rows only at 0 h.
Removed 'arbors' and technical aria-label jargon; guarded by claims.test.mjs.

findings.text: MAX_LAB_WORN_HOURS = 16; Practice scenario { start: 24, worn: 12, still: 12 }
findings.finding: Slipping-clutch 42 h cap (clippedByClutch) is now genuinely reachable and testable in both Lab and Practice.

findings.text: Release: 1 tooth step per tick; 14 h worn + 10 h still = 24 h day
findings.finding: Clarified Step 3 HUD tooth step wording and aligned VARIANTS.active to a full 24 h day with 60 swings/h.

findings.text: Parked rotor and Predict card clearance
findings.finding: Rotor parks cleanly on the left clear of #explainer and heading; #predict sits clear of the calibrePlate rim in light & dark modes.
Top-left heading sits completely in clean stage whitespace clear of calibrePlate; rotor clears #explainer.

findings.text: Receded upper dial bezel clearance from Step 4 heading
findings.finding: Receded upper exhibition dial and shadow stay cleanly clear of the top-left Gear train heading in light & dark modes.
Gear train leader routes cleanly from the right onto the exposed brass third wheel rim with 0% crossing.
Removed orphan off-center barrel axis line; only the true concentric central axis links the 3 exploded layers.
